purpose: Track line-owned Category A topology and Category B station-infrastructure evidence by official color family without promoting DPR proposals into current operational station data.
rules: A color family is for discovery and display. Each corridor retains its own systemCode, station identifiers, topology, temporal status, and Category A/B records.
DPR facts are PROPOSED evidence, even when a corridor has since become operational. Promote them only after crosswalk and as-built/operator confirmation.
Interchange entities link corridor-owned station records; do not merge levels, platform counts, or station totals across lines.
Unknown level counts, platform numbering, and directions remain unknown when the available source does not establish them.
